Section 1.

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+(b) "Disability" means a physical or mental impairment of a veteran that receives a disability rating under United States Code, title 38. +]

[+(c) "Municipality" means a county, statutory or home rule charter city, or town. +]

[+(d) "Residential improvement" means a remodel, renovation, or other improvement to a residential property that requires a license, building permit, inspection, or other approval by a municipality. +]

[+(e) "Veteran" has the meaning given in section 197.447. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Municipal fees waived; veterans with a disability.+]

[+A municipality may not charge a fee under section 326B.148, 326B.151, 326B.153, 326B.154, 326B.184, 326B.37, 326B.49, 326B.92, 326B.986, or 462.353 or any other law or rule authorizing the imposition of a fee by a municipality for a residential improvement that is required to accommodate the disability of a veteran who resides on the property. +]

[+Subd. 3.+]

[+Nonpayment of fee.+]

[+A municipality is prohibited from refusing to issue a license, building permit, or other approval or conduct an inspection or other necessary activity for a residential improvement required to accommodate the disability of a veteran due to the nonpayment of an associated fee. +]

[+Subd. 4.+]

[+Application; proof of veteran status required.+]

[+(a) Nothing in this section relieves an individual from a requirement to complete and submit an application, a form, or other documentation to obtain a license, building permit, or other approval or for the completion of an inspection or other activity necessary for a residential improvement. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to local government; prohibiting the imposition of certain fees for residential improvements necessary to accommodate the disability of a veteran; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 326B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[326B.161] FEES WAIVED FOR RESIDENTIAL IMPROVEMENT FOR VETERAN WITH A DISABILITY.

Subdivision 1.

Definitions.

(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.

(b) "Disability" means a physical or mental impairment of a veteran that receives a disability rating under United States Code, title 38.

(c) "Municipality" means a county, statutory or home rule charter city, or town.

(d) "Residential improvement" means a remodel, renovation, or other improvement to a residential property that requires a license, building permit, inspection, or other approval by a municipality.

(e) "Veteran" has the meaning given in section 197.447.

Subd. 2.

Municipal fees waived; veterans with a disability.

A municipality may not charge a fee under section 326B.148, 326B.151, 326B.153, 326B.154, 326B.184, 326B.37, 326B.49, 326B.92, 326B.986, or 462.353 or any other law or rule authorizing the imposition of a fee by a municipality for a residential improvement that is required to accommodate the disability of a veteran who resides on the property.

Subd. 3.

Nonpayment of fee.

A municipality is prohibited from refusing to issue a license, building permit, or other approval or conduct an inspection or other necessary activity for a residential improvement required to accommodate the disability of a veteran due to the nonpayment of an associated fee.

Subd. 4.

Application; proof of veteran status required.

(a) Nothing in this section relieves an individual from a requirement to complete and submit an application, a form, or other documentation to obtain a license, building permit, or other approval or for the completion of an inspection or other activity necessary for a residential improvement.

(b) A veteran must provide proof of veteran status and attest in the form and manner required by the municipality that a residential remodel or renovation is required to accommodate the veteran's disability.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
